title: Integer shifts compatible with the pinned pullback counits
statement: For schemes with chosen derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] and additive tensor pullbacks [def-pc-module-pullback], there exist coherent integer shift comparisons for each derived pullback [def-pc-derived-pullback], such that the left-derived counit selected by [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition] commutes with shifts, including the localization and termwise tensor-pullback shift comparisons.

source.place: Canonical base-change mate; Tag 0D5S derived pullback composition; Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Shift/SingleFunctors.lean and Mathlib/Algebra/Homology/DerivedCategory/Basic.lean. Shift verification written by N1.

proof.text: For each morphism, the counit selected by the composition theorem makes the chosen pullback a right Kan extension of termwise tensor pullback followed by Qh. Apply the generic coherent-shift theorem to this right Kan extension, Qh, and the termwise functor; it supplies a coherent shift structure making exactly this counit commute with shifts. Choose these structures for all morphisms and retain their compatibility proofs.

proof_origin.place: N1: specialization of rightKanExtension_coherentShift to the composition-pinned counits.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_pinned_pullback_counit_shifts
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ {Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (k : Y ⟶ Z), (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback k).Additive] :
    ∃ s : ∀ {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y), (derivedPullback.{u, w} f).CommShift ℤ,
      ∀ {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y),
        letI := s f
        NatTrans.CommShift (pinnedPullbackCounit.{u, w} f) ℤ
